cases.description: The record is added to the ANSWER section (Section.ANSWER). The method should iterate over sections, find the non‑null list that contains the record and return true.
The record is added to the AUTHORITY section (Section.AUTHORITY). The loop reaches this section, sees a non‑null list that contains the record and returns true.
The record is added to the ADDITIONAL section (Section.ADDITIONAL). The method should locate it and return true.
The internal `sections` array of the Message instance is null. When `findRecord` iterates and attempts to access `sections[i]`, a NullPointerException should be thrown.

The `sections` array is initialized with a length smaller than the highest section index (Section.ADDITIONAL). During the loop, accessing an out‑of‑range index triggers an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
